Critical thinking is the disciplined art of evaluating evidence, questioning unexamined assumptions,
and distinguishing verifiable facts from persuasive rhetoric. In an era saturated with algorithmic
news feeds and rapid misinformation, the ability to cross-check primary sources has become an
indispensable civic skill. Education systems that prioritize rote memorization over inquiry-based
learning leave students ill-equipped to navigate complex public debates and make informed
decisions.

କର୍ତ୍ତବ୍ୟନିଷ୍ଠାର ସମନ୍ୱୟ ଏକାନ୍ତ ଅପରିହାର୍ଯ୍ୟ।
